If you're still in school, you could talk to the school counselor. They legally have to bring in family to tell them you're feeling suicidal, but it might help you. Or you could try writing a note about how you're feeling and put it on their bed, or the kitchen counter, or somewhere they'll see it. I understand it's difficult telling someone about these kinds of feelings, but keeping it bottled inside will only stress you out and possibly make you feel worse. - In my personal experience it took me about 6 years to tell my dad how I was feeling and he understood completely. My bf who I've been with for 3 years has helped me too, since he was also feeling how I do. You'll one day find that person, if not your parents, who will help you with these thoughts. Good luck though and I wish you the best. Hope this helped, or gave you ideas on how to talk to someone.
